competences.description: Attacks the enemy to stun for 1 turn with a 30% chance. The damage increases according to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times. Each hit leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 50% chance and decreases its Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 20% chance.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Increases your Attack Speed for 1 turn after attacking the enemy on your turn. Deals damage that ignores Defense in proportion to the Attack Speed difference in boss battles. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
effets.note: When attacking on your turn, in proportion to the Attack Speed difference, in boss battles.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
